Subject: Initial pass: integration gaps for AWS listing

Hey Soojin —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As promised I'm attaching a first-pass checklist of technical items CloudBridge sees as blockers to an AWS Marketplace SaaS listing and co-sell qualification for the Redwood Dedicated offering. High-level gaps we noticed:

- Metering: need to confirm the metering API and how consumption maps to "vCPU-hours" units used by the marketplace.
- Private offer flow: contract and pricing automation for ISV private offers (DocuSign hooks).
- AMI/container artifacts: verification policy for marketplace images vs. our private repo build.
- Support handoff: channel and contact for co-sell escalations.
- Billing reconciliation: statements and ingestion cadence.

I've cc'd Lauren from AWS to make sure we capture required artifacts on their side. Can you share a technical owner and an expected ETA for the items in the checklist?

Attaching: redwood_marketplace_checklist_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with tabs: artifacts, metering, legal, ops)

Best,
Amit
Principal Cloud Solutions

Amit — thanks for the thorough pass. Looping in Jonas (product) and Marissa (partnerships) who'll own the tech deliverables and commercial side respectively. Quick answers and owners below: 

- Metering: Jonas will lead. We currently expose a usage API that reports "token_ms" and "inference_ms" — mapping to a marketplace unit is a translation layer we can implement. ETA: prototype in 3 weeks.
- Private offer flow: Marissa will run procurement/legal discussions. We can accept private offers but need to confirm DocuSign integration points.
- Artifacts: engineering prefers publishing container images to ECR + a lightweight manifest that marketplace can verify. We'll share the integration-diagram.png.
- Support handoff: we propose a shared escalation Slack channel + a weekly co-sell review cadence.
- Billing reconciliation: we can provide daily reconciliation CSVs; need to confirm format with AWS billing team.

Attachments: integration-diagram.png (high-level architecture).

Next steps: Jonas to share a short tech plan by 3/18, Marissa to schedule a procurement sync with Lauren.

Thanks,
Soojin

Hey all — a quick technical plan. Amit, thanks for the checklist — I broke it into actionable pieces and estimated effort: 

1) Metering translation layer (2 sprints) — implement exporter that consumes our internal usage stream and emits marketplace meter events. Needs a signing key for deliveries to AWS (action: Lauren to advise on signing).
2) Artifact verification (1 sprint) — publish container images to a verified ECR path + manifest generation. We'll add a CI job to produce the manifest.
3) Private offers automation (1 sprint + legal work) — webhook for DocuSign status updates into our procurement service.
4) Reconciliation CSV (0.5 sprint) — format sample attached.

Risks: the metering map depends on whether AWS will accept a composite metric vs a single unit. If they require per-token granularity we will need extra instrumentation.

I'll post RFC and sample API stubs to the Drive link this afternoon.

-Jonas

Thanks team — this looks good. A few clarifications from AWS Marketplace: 

- Metering: AWS supports both single-unit metering and custom metering with upserts. For initial listing, recommend single-unit "Redwood Compute Hour" mapped to your internal inference_ms aggregated per customer month. Custom metering requires a partner onboarding step but is supported.
- Private offers: DocuSign webhooks are fine; you should create an IAM role with logs enabled for delivery.
- Image verification: ECR path + manifest are acceptable; include SHA256 checksums.
- Co-sell: to be eligible you must have a valid seller profile and at least one customer order through the marketplace in a quarter; we'll run a co-sell eligibility check after the first private offer closes.

I'll loop in the marketplace onboarding engineer separately for the seller profile steps. My note: try to get the metering prototype done ahead of the co-sell deadline so we can fast-track review.

—Lauren
AWS Marketplace GTM
